title: Finite coefficient K-flat representatives give fully faithful restriction
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring and X a scheme. Let P consist of unbounded cochain complexes of etale sheaves of ULift A-modules whose inverse image in the intrinsic constant-ring module category is K-flat. For any category D, restriction along the product of the two inclusions P → complexes → derived category is fully faithful on functors into D. The intrinsic K-flat test is the actual direct-sum total tensor test of [def-pc-kflat-complex].

source.place: Final site-transport paragraph; Stacks Project, Cohomology on Sites, Tags 06YN and 07A4.

proof.text: Resolve every etale complex by the functorial flat resolution. Ordinary inverse image preserves these K-flat resolutions, by flat preservation.

Intrinsic realization is an exact tensor equivalence. Use its inverse on every acyclic intrinsic test complex, transfer the total-tensor test through the equivalence, and transport along the counit. This makes the image of the flat resolution intrinsically K-flat.
Pass these quasi-isomorphisms to the homotopy category, apply resolving-representative restriction, and transport the resulting fully faithful restriction along quotientCompQhIso on both factors.

theorem finiteCoefficientKFlatRepresentativesFullyFaithful
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (T : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u})
    [hD : HasDerivedCategory.{s} (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)))]
    (D : Type w) [Category.{v} D] :
    let C := Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A))
    let P : ObjectProperty (CochainComplex C ℤ) := fun P ↦
      @CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        T.ProEt inferInstance (essentiallySmallSelf.{0, u, u + 1} _)
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology T)
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.proEtaleConstantRing T A)
        (((AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.finiteCoefficientIntrinsicComparison
          T A).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj P)
    Nonempty (((Functor.whiskeringLeft (P.FullSubcategory × P.FullSubcategory)
      (DerivedCategory C × DerivedCategory C) D).obj
      ((P.ι ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q).prod (P.ι ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q))).FullyFaithful)
